rating: Config good_ssim .90 and baseline_ssim .75 inclusive; A/B/C for good/okay/fail with valid format and >=1 scored case, F if invalid format or zero predicted. A/B resolved. Completion .9 is a progress gate, not an A/B gate.
rules: Mask >0.5 ROI, empty mask falls back full volume. MAE/RMSE HU and PSNR dB use un-clipped HU differences and range4095. SSIM clips CT to[-1024,3071], averages full x-y slices along axis2, skips mask slice sum<16 or min dimension<7; optional scikit-image failure returns None, not per-pixel masked SSIM.
